missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Служба' is the feminine nominative subject of 'началась'. 'Его' shows whose service it is, and 'рано утром' gives the time.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Службу' is the accusative direct object of 'любит', taking the regular feminine accusative ending. 'Свою' agrees in the feminine accusative.

missions.phrase: У него нет времени из-за службы.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive with 'из-за'. 'Службы' is genitive after the compound preposition 'из-за', marking the cause. A natural way to blame a busy schedule.
Strategic focus: Dative object. 'Службе' is the dative case after 'предан', the thing one is devoted to. 'Своей' agrees in the feminine dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental object. 'Службой' is the instrumental case required by 'доволен', the source of satisfaction. 'Своей' agrees in the feminine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional with 'на'. 'Службе' is the prepositional form after 'на', meaning at work or on duty. A short, very common everyday statement.
Strategic focus: Prepositional with 'на'. 'Службе' is again the prepositional after 'на' marking the location. 'Друга' is the accusative animate object, a natural workplace anecdote.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Службы' is the nominative plural, the subject of 'работают'. 'Городские' agrees in the plural, describing municipal services.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Служб' is the genitive plural required after 'много'. 'Полезных' agrees in the genitive plural, and 'в городе' is the prepositional place.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'Службу' is accusative after 'на', marking the destination. 'Пешком' is the adverb of manner, a routine commuting line.
